correctness.rationale: For y^5-y=x^2+x+x^(-1) over F5, poles at zero and infinity have orders one and two, giving genus six, two rational fully ramified points, and 5-rank four. Over F_(5^n), the Artin–Schreier map has five preimages precisely on trace-zero values; hence #C=2+5*#nonzero x with Tr(x²+x+x^(-1))=0. An independent finite-field enumeration for n=1..6 gave N=(2,2,77,602,3022,16337), matching the package. Weil sums S=(4,24,49,24,104,-711) and Newton identities plus the genus-six functional equation give P coefficients (1,-4,-4,21,46,-100,-85,-500,1150,2625,-2500,-12500,15625). Exact P(1)=3775; irreducibility mod 3 follows by Rabin X^(3^12)=X and gcd tests at exponents 3^6,3^4, giving base-field simple Jacobian. Valuations v5 of coefficients produce Newton hull vertices (0,0),(4,0),(8,2),(12,6), slopes 0^4,1/2^4,1^4. The finite point counts are exhaustive for the six required extension degrees; the functional equation is what completes the full zeta polynomial; simplicity is not claimed geometrically.
residual_risks: Finite independent tests corroborate only tested parameters; universal argument is from source proof and standard theorem applications.
